# External dependency

`scripts/setup_env.sh` clones MMDetection at the revision used by this project:

```text
https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection.git
cfd5d3a985b0249de009b67d04f37263e11cdf3d
```

The repository contains MMDetection's `projects/CO-DETR` implementation and the
public Co-DINO configuration used here.
